decision_contract.question: Under the real vote/credit law on a from-clean-parent contiguous replay, how long do votes that eventually cause an applied flip live, what fraction of vote mass never converts, does old mass still convert, and how do |acc| magnitudes survive — enough to select a forgetting-mechanism family without building it yet?
decision_contract.named_overforget_risk: functional_veto_freeze (votes never cross → ternary stops training)

in: New screen script sibling to hrm_text_158_acc_entropy_screen.py (CPU; compact histograms/quantiles/survival only)
Read-only load of banked parent weights; derive q via BitLinear law; start acc/backlog empty (from-clean-parent contiguous)
Replay vote/credit stream via imported project_s1_gradient_to_moves + same grad path as entropy screen
Pre-registered branch classifier binding measurement outcomes → forgetting-mechanism family
Banked .pt sha256 before+after; runtime artifacts only under artifacts/acc_entropy/
Focused CPU validation of screen CLI dry-shape after +1 implement (no science claim until receipt)
out: No forgetting-mechanism implementation (decay/TTL/sparse) in this slice
No GPU / lane / Monitor / VCS / .pt commit
No raw per-proposal / per-weight lifetime arrays in receipt

banked_parent.note: No persistent integer q/acc in this banked ckpt; q derived; acc starts zero (matches entropy screen + resume-empty backlog invariant)

vote_stream_replay_path.weights: FROZEN (no q updates) — same honest limit as entropy screen
vote_stream_replay_path.grad_path: hrm_text_158_rotor_backward_saved_screen._loss_and_grads over exhaustive A0 supports, batch=8, seed=1000+step
vote_stream_replay_path.primary_drain_arm_for_lifetime: armC_topk (K=1024) — closest live applied-rate-cap analog; armB_drain_all as uncapped comparison; armA_backlog reports mass-only (zero applied flips by construction)

a_flip_lifetime_distribution.def: For each applied flip (drain that resets a crossed weight), lifetime_steps = flip_step - first_nonzero_credit_step_on_that_weight_since_last_reset (or window start if never zeroed).
a_flip_lifetime_distribution.emit: histogram counts over fixed bins [1,2,3-4,5-8,9-16,17-32,33-64,65-128,129-150] + quantiles p10/p25/p50/p75/p90/p99 + n_flips

b_drainable_mass_fraction.def: drainable_mass = sum |acc| over weights with zero applied flips in window; credited_mass = sum |move| over all steps; never_convert_frac = drainable_mass_at_end / max(1, sum_end_|acc|); also mass_never_flipped_frac of final |acc| mass.

c_age_conditioned_flip_probability.def: Partition active (nonzero acc) weights into age bins; per bin: flips_in_bin / active_weight_steps_in_bin (hazard-like rate).
c_age_conditioned_flip_probability.emit: per-bin rates + exposure counts; no per-weight dumps

d_acc_magnitude_survival.def: For thresholds M in {1,2,5,10,20,40,80}, Kaplan-Meier-style survival S(age)=P(|acc|>=M still holds at age) using compact at-risk/event counts per age bin.

measurements.working_memory_ok_not_in_receipt: optional per-weight first_credit_step uint16 maps (~O(numel)) allowed in process RAM only; never serialized to receipt

selection_rules_exact.if: armC p50_flip_lifetime <= 8 AND age_bin_rate(age>32) / max(eps, age_bin_rate(age<=8)) <= 0.25 AND never_convert_frac >= 0.50
selection_rules_exact.why: conversion is recent-dominated; old mass mostly dead → hard age drain is informative

selection_rules_exact.if: armC p50_flip_lifetime >= 32 AND age_bin_rate(age>32) / max(eps, age_bin_rate(age<=8)) >= 0.60
selection_rules_exact.why: old mass still converts; need gradual forget not hard TTL that would kill converters

selection_rules_exact.if: never_convert_frac >= 0.70 AND armC p50_flip_lifetime <= 16 AND (R1 not exclusive)
selection_rules_exact.why: most mass never contributes; keep hot converters, forget cold bulk

selection_rules_exact.if: armC n_flips < 1000 OR final zero_frac > 0.95 on drain arm with near-zero credited mass
selection_rules_exact.why: vacuous screen — do not pick a forgetting family

selection_rules_exact.then: prefer F3 over F2 over F1; emit multi_match=true
selection_rules_exact.why: over-forget risk: protect converter tier before uniform decay
